description: Upscales a video and/or interpolates frames for higher resolution and frame rate (Topaz Video Enhance).

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

duration_sec.description: Source video duration in seconds. Required.

interpolation_duplicate.description: Analyze the input for duplicate frames and remove them.

interpolation_enabled.description: Enable the frame-interpolation filter. At least one of `upscaler_enabled` or `interpolation_enabled` must be true.

interpolation_frame_rate.description: Output frame rate when interpolation is enabled.

interpolation_slowmo.description: Slow-motion factor. e.g. 2 makes the output twice as slow and doubles the duration.

src_height.description: Source video height in pixels. Required (no ffprobe in node).

src_size_bytes.description: Source video file size in bytes. Required.

src_width.description: Source video width in pixels. Required (no ffprobe in node).

upscaler_enabled.description: Enable the upscaling filter. At least one of `upscaler_enabled` or `interpolation_enabled` must be true.

upscaler_model.description: Upscaler model: 'Starlight (Astra) Fast' (slf-1), 'Starlight (Astra) Creative' (slc-1, supports `upscaler_creativity`), or 'Starlight Precise 2.5' (slp-2.5).

upscaler_resolution.description: Target upscaler resolution: 'FullHD (1080p)' (long-side cap 1920) or '4K (2160p)' (long-side cap 3840). Aspect ratio is preserved and target dims are rounded up to even.
